title: NVIDIA launches SkillSpectre to scan AI agent skills for #NVIDIA #SkillSpectre #AIAgentSecurity
description: NVIDIA launched SkillSpectre, an open-source scanner that detects malicious AI agent skills before installation. It analyzed over 42,000 skills and found that one in four could compromise user systems. SkillSpectre scans directories, zip files, or GitHub URLs against 71 vulnerability checks, including prompt injection and dangerous code calls. It assigns a risk score from 0 to 100, with anything above 50 flagged as unsafe. The tool can run as a server to automatically scan skills for AI agents, improving security in AI marketplaces. This innovation addresses growing concerns about malware embedded in AI skill sets, helping users and developers safeguard their systems. #NVIDIA #SkillSpectre #AIAgentSecurity #MalwareDetection #OpenSourceSecurity #AIThreats #VulnerabilityScanner #PromptInjection #AIHacking #AIMarketplace #Cybersecurity #AgentSkills #TechInnovation #SoftwareSecurity #AIProtection
